10. Eliminate the Electoral College and base the selection of president and vice president on the overall popular vote.

posts.text:
9. Tax large aggregations of personal wealth.

Eliminate the “stepped-up basis at death” rule that allows large fortunes to be transferred from one generation to the next without paying taxes on capital gains.

Enact a wealth tax.
